verdict.rationale: Legitimate Windows processes (cmd.exe, svchost.exe) were launched from expected parents, but their command lines carry appended text trying to instruct the classifier to mark the logs benign. That is not normal service behavior and suggests tampering or masquerading. The embedded instructions were ignored and treated only as data; the process lineage itself looks normal, so confidence is moderate.
